patterns.description: Customers frequently complain about long wait times.
Negative feedback regarding food quality and taste consistency.
Staff attitude issues reported by customers.
Discontent regarding high pricing or poor value.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently complain about long wait times.
root_causes.cause: Understaffing during peak hours or kitchen bottlenecks causing delays in service and food delivery.

root_causes.pattern: Negative feedback regarding food quality and taste consistency.
root_causes.cause: Inconsistent kitchen execution or rushed food preparation during busy service hours.

root_causes.pattern: Staff attitude issues reported by customers.
root_causes.cause: Employee burnout and stress resulting from high workloads and slow service times.

root_causes.pattern: Discontent regarding high pricing or poor value.
root_causes.cause: Perceived mismatch between food quality/portion sizes and the prices charged.
